title: Inbox One
intro: An initial explorations of an email inbox style agents window homepage.
questions: Is it confusing that the big chat composer is only for new chats, while follow up messages sent to an existing session must be sent via the composer inside a list item?
There's no indication of what environment a session is running in. Does it feel important to include that info?
How does it feel to have expanded content live underneath the list item? Would you prefer this content to be in a second column to the right of the list?
